title: Async Request Engine Check
prompt:
Implement three async helpers:

1. `createLoader(fetchFn)` RETURNS `{ load, reset }`. `load(key)` calls `fetchFn(key)` once per key and RETURNS the resulting promise; concurrent and later calls with the same key RETURN THE SAME promise. `reset()` clears all cached promises (the next load re-fetches).
2. `loadDashboard(sources)` where `sources` is an array of zero-argument promise-returning functions. It runs ALL of them concurrently and RETURNS a promise for `{ loaded, failed }` — `loaded` is the array of fulfilled values (in order), `failed` the array of rejection reasons (in order). It never rejects.
3. `withTimeout(promise, ms, fallback)` RETURNS a promise that settles with the promise's value if it fulfills within `ms`, otherwise with `fallback`. It never rejects.

tests.name: loader dedupes concurrent requests per key
tests.hint: Keep a Map of key → promise in the closure; store the promise (not the value) so in-flight requests are shared. reset() = map.clear().

tests.name: loadDashboard separates fulfilled and rejected
tests.hint: Promise.allSettled, then split results on status === 'fulfilled'.

tests.name: withTimeout resolves value or fallback
tests.hint: Promise.race([promise, timerPromise]) where the timer resolves with fallback after ms.
